reason: A DSH Web GUI plugin that monitors OpenCodeGo rolling, weekly, and monthly quota usage, presenting color-coded status and progress details with periodic refresh.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中监控 OpenCodeGo 的滚动、每周和每月额度，并通过状态指示灯与进度面板显示剩余额度及重置时间。
summaries.en: Monitors OpenCodeGo rolling, weekly, and monthly quota usage in the DSH Web GUI with a status indicator and progress panel showing remaining amounts and reset times.

capabilities: Reads an API key from DSH credentials, process environment, or a local state file
Stores a manually entered API key in a state file under DSH_HOME unless overridden by OCG_STATE_PATH
Makes authenticated HTTPS requests to the OpenCodeGo quota endpoint
Registers a same-origin web route and renders a quota indicator and progress panel in the DSH web interface
Automatically refreshes quota data every two minutes
